environment.description: EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, i-0a3f8b2c) running legacy Java monolith with EFS mount at /opt/monolith. Lambda function URL configured with AuthType=NONE, allowing any internet caller to POST ZIP archives. The function extracts configs to the shared EFS volume. No network restrictions on the function URL endpoint. Security group sg-0def4a allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
